howItWorks.title: From sign up to signed deal
howItWorks.subtitle: Five steps. No cold outreach, no gatekeeping — just the introduction that moves your work forward.

1.title: Sign Up
1.description: Create a free account in under two minutes. Tell us whether you are investing, building, hiring or raising.

2.title: Create Your Profile
2.description: Add your sector, stage, ticket size or expertise. The more specific you are, the sharper your matches.

3.title: Get Matched by AI
3.description: Our AI pairs you with the people whose goals, stage and geography align with yours — no spray-and-pray outreach.

4.title: Connect & Chat
4.description: Start a conversation inside a private dealroom. See who you're talking to, verify credibility, and move the conversation forward.

5.title: Close the Deal
5.description: Agree on terms, wire the funds, sign the contract. Close your first deal on AfroConnect — then come back for the next one.

aiExplained.headline: What our AI actually does for you
aiExplained.subheadline: No buzzwords. Three concrete jobs the matching engine does every time you use AfroConnect.

smartMatching.title: Smart Matching
smartMatching.example: Our AI matches fintech investors with founders in Africa who are raising seed funding.
smartMatching.supporting: It reads sector, stage, ticket size and location on both sides, so an investor writing $250K seed cheques into fintech sees exactly those founders — not a feed of everyone.

profileOptimization.title: Profile Optimization
profileOptimization.example: Adding your funding stage helps investors find and understand your startup faster.
profileOptimization.supporting: We tell you which specific field is missing and what it unlocks — add your raise amount and you appear in the searches investors are already running.

compatibilityScores.title: Compatibility Scores
compatibilityScores.example: See at a glance how closely your goals align with a potential investor or co-founder.
compatibilityScores.supporting: Every suggested connection carries a score and a plain-English reason, so you know why the match was made before you send the first message.

aiExplained.whatMatchLooksLike: What a match looks like in practice
aiExplained.matchExamples: Illustrative examples of the matches the engine produces — every one carries a score and a reason.
